title: Setup
description: Typed view of the Setup area.

current_patch.description: The currently-selected patch (read/write: writing recalls that patch).

PatchLetter.description: Which of a bank's three patches a [`PatchRef`] points at.

PatchRef.description:
A reference to a stored patch — bank `1..=99` and slot A/B/C — as used by the
Setup "current patch" field and every Program-Change-map entry.

Wire encoding: a single index `0..=296` (`0 = 01A`, `1 = 01B`, `2 = 01C`,
`3 = 02A`, … `296 = 99C`), nibble-packed across 3 bytes. YAML: `{ bank: 12,
slot: b }`.
